title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - English Studies - Phrasal Verbs
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Due to severe financial difficulties, James had to ________ of school in his second year.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'drop out' means to abandon a course of study or leave school or university before completion.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

The traffic warden signaled the speeding driver to ________ so he could inspect his driver's license.
questions.explain: 'Pull over' is a phrasal verb meaning to move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Knowing a shortage was coming, the trader decided to ________ on essential goods before prices went up.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'stock up' means to buy or accumulate a large quantity of something, usually to ensure you have enough for the future.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

To ensure consumer safety, the regulatory agency has ordered manufacturers to gradually ________ the use of specific toxic chemical preservatives in food packaging.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'phase out' means to gradually stop using, producing, or providing something, often done for safety or regulatory compliance.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

It was a highly dangerous internal surgery, but the expert surgeons remained optimistic that the young patient would ________.
questions.explain: In health and medical contexts, to 'pull through' means to survive a dangerous, critical, or difficult situation, especially a severe illness or complicated surgery.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

As future leaders, the nation expects the youths to consistently ________ the exceptional moral and ethical standards strictly established by the nation's founding fathers.
questions.explain: To 'live up to' is a phrasal verb meaning to do as well as one was expected to, fulfilling expectations or adhering strictly to an established high standard.
questions.subject: English Studies
